title: Dust Dissolve
desc: Turn any Jetpack Compose view into dust, with an AGSL shader and a particle cloud.
long: Turn any view into dust. A shader eats the view away in any direction, and a cloud of pastel dots is born exactly where it disappears, then flows to a target, drifts off, falls or bursts. Built for a coupon flowing into a total, but it works for dismissing cards, deleting rows, avatars and whole grids. The view never leaves the layout, so nothing around it moves.
params: A light line crosses the view before it dissolves. Default true.
Which way the view is eaten away: LeftToRight, RightToLeft, TopToBottom, BottomToTop or CenterOut.
Where the dust goes: flow to a target, drift in one direction, or burst outward.
Rectangle, or ellipse for round views so no dots appear in the empty corners.
When the view is eaten away, in seconds since fire(). Default 0.55 to 1.10.
When the cloud starts moving and the random extra delay per dot.
Any list of colors, picked at random per dot. Default pastel.
Random seed. Give each view its own for variety.
